title: Anti-inflammatory activity and mechanism of action of Banxia Xiexin Decoction on DSS-induced ulcerative colitis in mice.
authors: Zhang, Xiuli; Yu, Yan; Yu, Lihong; Wu, Cheng; Chen, Yangyi; Wang, Jingting; Chen, Hui; Xu, Chao; Lin, Jiumao; Zhang, Xueyan; Wang, Qingshui; Assaraf, Yehuda G; Lin, Yao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究半夏泻心汤对小鼠溃疡性结肠炎的抗炎作用及NF-κB通路机制，虽含分子对接但核心为中药药效与湿实验验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Banxia Xiexin Decoction (BXD) is a Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) formulation, historically utilized in the treatment of ulcerative colitis (UC). However, its precise active constituents and the underlying mechanisms of action remain insufficiently understood. AIM OF THE STUDY: We herein aimed to explore the molecular mechanisms by which BXD mitigates dextran sodium sulfate (DSS)-induced UC in mice. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Ultra-performance liquid chromatograph-hybrid quadrupole orbitrap high resolution mass spectrometry, network pharmacology and molecular docking were employed to identify active compounds and possible targets of BXD in UC. The protective impact of BXD treatment of DSS-stimulated UC in mice was assessed via analysis of pathological alterations and their mitigation. Pro-inflammatory cytokine levels were determined using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) was employed to explore the mechanism(s) underlying BXD activity in UC. The related pathway protein expression was evaluated by immunohistochemistry. RESULTS: We first analyzed serum samples and detected 15 prototype chemical components from BXD. Database searches identified 271 genes as being correlated with these 15 prototype chemical components in BXD and 1519 genes associated with UC. We observed that oral BXD treatment ameliorated UC symptoms in mice, reducing weight loss, colon shortening, mucosal epithelium damage, and inflammation, while increasing goblet cell-mediated mucous production. Furthermore, BXD treatment repressed tumor necrosis factor-alpha, interleukin-6, and interleukin-1-beta levels in the serum of mice. RNA-seq and comprehensive network pharmacology analyses revealed a significant enrichment of nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) pathways. Mechanistically, BXD treatment potently suppressed activation of the inhibitor of kappa B kinase (IkappaK)/inhibitor of NF-kappaB (IkappaB)/NF-kappaB pathway. CONCLUSION: These findings suggest that BXD may attenuate the pro-inflammatory response and alleviate symptoms of UC by modulating the IkappaK/IkappaB/NF-kappaB pathway. Hence, we identify a potential pharmaceutical candidate and an innovative therapeutic approach for UC intervention.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：半夏泻心汤（BXD）是一种传统中药（TCM）制剂，历史上用于治疗溃疡性结肠炎（UC）。然而，其精确的活性成分和潜在的作用机制仍未被充分理解。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨BXD减轻葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的小鼠UC的分子机制。材料与方法：采用超高效液相色谱-四极杆-静电场轨道阱高分辨质谱、网络药理学和分子对接技术，鉴定BXD在UC中的活性化合物及可能靶点。通过分析病理变化及其缓解情况，评估BXD对DSS刺激的小鼠UC的保护作用。使用酶联免疫吸附测定法检测促炎细胞因子水平。采用RNA测序（RNA-seq）探讨BXD在UC中作用的潜在机制。通过免疫组织化学评估相关通路蛋白表达。结果：我们首先分析了血清样本，检测到来自BXD的15种原型化学成分。数据库搜索识别出271个与BXD中这15种原型化学成分相关的基因，以及1519个与UC相关的基因。我们观察到，口服BXD治疗改善了小鼠的UC症状，减少了体重减轻、结肠缩短、黏膜上皮损伤和炎症，同时增加了杯状细胞介导的黏液产生。此外，BXD治疗抑制了小鼠血清中肿瘤坏死因子-α、白细胞介素-6和白细胞介素-1β的水平。RNA-seq和综合网络药理学分析揭示了核因子κB（NF-kappaB）通路的显著富集。机制上，BXD治疗有效抑制了κB激酶抑制剂（IkappaK）/NF-κB抑制剂（IkappaB）/NF-κB通路的激活。结论：这些发现表明，BXD可能通过调节IkappaK/IkappaB/NF-κB通路来减轻促炎反应并缓解UC症状。因此，我们确定了一个潜在的药物候选物和一种创新的UC干预治疗策略。
